required.name: MJ_HUB_MCP_URL
required.sourceOfTruth: The curated MJ remote Hub lane.
required.rotation: Update only when the named lane URL changes.
required.notes: Register this as the Dify MCP server URL for provider_id `mj_hub`.

required.name: MJ_HUB_MANAGED_BEARER_TOKEN
required.sourceOfTruth: Managed bearer token issued under policy.user-bearer-token-governance.v1.
required.rotation: Rotate or revoke through CREATE SOMETHING identity flows. Never mint or edit directly in Dify.
required.notes: Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when Dify connects to the MJ Hub MCP server.

optional.name: CS_DIFY_MODERATION_BASE_URL
optional.sourceOfTruth: CREATE SOMETHING moderation service for Dify input/output review.
optional.rotation: Update if the moderation service URL changes.
optional.notes: Use only when the app is wired to Dify moderation extensions.

optional.name: CS_DIFY_MODERATION_SHARED_SECRET
optional.sourceOfTruth: Shared secret between Dify and the moderation service.
optional.rotation: Rotate on extension rollout or incident response.
optional.notes: Not required until moderation is enabled.

outOfScope.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
outOfScope.reason: Model-provider credentials are workspace-level and are not part of this app-specific contract.
